title: Canon record — report
description: Full record model for a canon report: title, tags, metadata.canon (the envelope) and body. The body must contain the fixed EN H2 sections listed in x-canon-sections, each as an exact '^## <name>$' line — enforced by tools/validate.py, which reads the annotation. Unknown properties inside metadata.canon are forbidden by the envelope; unknown record-level fields are tolerated (server-owned fields such as agent, project and dates may live on the record). The title must be a non-empty single line of at most 80 characters.

title.description: Non-empty single-line title, max 80 chars. For a report: what period or slice it covers, in plain language.

tags.description: Record tags. Canon convention: project:<slug>, agent:<slug>, mnemos:session (or mnemos:checkpoint).

metadata.description: Record metadata. The canon envelope lives at metadata.canon.

body.description: Free-form body in the record language; must contain every x-canon-sections H2 header on its own line.
